blocks.text: Setting up Google Sheets on your Mac

Google Sheets is a web application. It does not have a native Mac app. You can create a dedicated window by using the Progressive Web App feature in Chrome. Open your sheet, click the three-dot menu in Chrome, select Cast, Save, and Share, then click Install page as app. This keeps your logistics data separate from your casual browsing tabs. It makes switching between your email and your spreadsheets much faster.

Speed matters when you are reconciling hundreds of rows. Use the built-in shortcut helper by pressing ⌘ + /. This opens a searchable list of every command available. For quick edits, use ⌘ + ⇧ + H to find and replace shipment IDs. If you need to hide sensitive columns during a presentation, use ⌘ + ⌥ + 0. To hide rows, use ⌘ + ⌥ + 9.

You often work with massive exports from your WMS or ERP systems. Google Sheets supports up to 20 million cells per file. If your file slows down, your data is likely too dense. Split your data into separate tabs by region or month. Use the IMPORTRANGE function to pull summary data into a master dashboard. This keeps your main file responsive and reduces the chance of errors.

Carrier data is rarely clean. You will often find duplicate tracking numbers or inconsistent date formats. Use the Data > Data cleanup > Remove duplicates tool to clean your lists. If your text is stuck in one cell, use Data > Split text to columns to separate shipment codes from carrier names. Always validate your data after these steps to ensure no critical information was lost.

Logistics analysts spend too much time on manual updates. Use Pivot Tables to summarize freight costs by carrier. Select your data, then go to Insert > Pivot table. This allows you to drag and drop fields to see trends without writing complex formulas. If you need to track unique values, use the COUNTUNIQUE function to get accurate shipment counts quickly.

When a shipment is delayed, you need to document the reason. Use Insert > Note to add context to a cell without changing the data. This is better than adding extra columns that clutter your analysis. If you need to dictate these notes, hold the fn key on your Mac keyboard. Lazur will type your observations directly into the note window for you.
If you are stuck, ask Lazur where a specific menu item is. It will draw a circle around the menu path so you do not have to hunt for it.
blocks.title: Find tools faster

faq.question: Is there a native Google Sheets app for Mac?
faq.answer: No. Google Sheets is a web-based tool. You can create a desktop shortcut using the Install page as app feature in Google Chrome to get a similar experience.

faq.question: How do I see all keyboard shortcuts in Google Sheets?
faq.answer: Press ⌘ + / on your Mac keyboard to open the full list of shortcuts inside the Google Sheets interface.

faq.question: What should I do if my sheet is running slowly?
faq.answer: Reduce the number of cells, remove unused formulas, or split your data into multiple tabs. Ensure you are not running too many browser extensions.
